title: Visions of Time
description: The Priest of Chronos has sealed a vision concerning the High Chronist's own order - something about how Thornfield's branch of the faith will read the coming season, not a warning meant for any single villager. He does not pretend the timing is favorable; the High Chronist may already have drawn her own conclusions by the time this reaches her. He sends it anyway, because a temple that stops recording its foresight because the hour has already passed has stopped practicing the faith at all.

objectives.description: Receive the sealed prophecy from the Priest of Chronos
Deliver the prophecy, whether or not it beats her own conclusions

notes: Same fix as chronos_03_late_delivery: no invented deadline, lateness accepted as doctrine rather than dramatized as a countdown. Threat: internal to the church - whether Thornfield's order trusts Dalhurst's readings. Giver motive: recording foresight is the practice itself, independent of whether it arrives first. Consequence: not wired. Known duplicate of chronos_03_late_delivery, deliberately differentiated - this copy concerns the Chronist orders' internal standing and is the church's own business; chronos_03 concerns the Thornfield mill wheel and a townsman's stake in the outcome.
